physiology:
This code sits in the connective tissue, the quiet weave that holds the body together. Skin, hair, the lining of the gut, the cartilage at the joints, the small tough things that keep one part of you reliably connected to the next. It is the part of the body least talked about and most depended on. Nothing in you stands up without it.

The shadow has a bodily floor here. Indifference does not announce itself as pain. It shows up as something looser, a slackness in the frame, a tiredness that sits under the muscle. The body feels poorly held, the way a house feels poorly held when the joists have softened. Plans drift because the structure for them drifts. The shrug is in the tissue before it ever reaches the mouth.

The climb out is also bodily, and quieter than expected. Versatility is felt first as a return of tension, the good kind, the kind that lets a person move from one thing to the next without losing themselves in the change. The body knits. Skin holds. The frame remembers how to carry weight again. Mastery, lower down than thought, is just this: the tissue strong enough to hold whatever the day brings, the weave fine enough to take any new use without tearing.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the tissue, the code answers to Cysteine. Cysteine carries sulfur, and sulfur is what the body uses to make its strongest small bonds, the bridges that hold a protein in its proper shape. Hair, nails, skin, the structures that take a beating and stay themselves, are held together by these bridges. Take the bridges away and the form falls apart.

There is a teaching in that. The card is about versatility, the knack of working in many fields and not coming apart between them. Lower down, the chemistry is doing the same work. It is making bonds that can take the load, can be broken and remade, can hold a shape through change. The same atom that lets the body cross from one form to another without losing itself runs underneath the gift this card carries. The talent is not invented. It is held in place by what already binds you.
